notYou: If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email. Nothing will change.

confirmation.subject: Confirm your email address
confirmation.heading: Confirm your email address
confirmation.body: Thanks for joining {{productName}}. Press the button to confirm your email address. Until you do, you can read stories but you can’t publish, comment, post or send messages.
confirmation.linkNote: The link works once and expires after an hour.

magicLink.subject: Your log-in link
magicLink.heading: Your log-in link
magicLink.body: Press the button to log in to {{productName}}. No password needed.
magicLink.linkNote: The link works once and expires after an hour.

recovery.subject: Reset your password
recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.body: Someone asked to reset the password for your {{productName}} account. If it was you, press the button to choose a new one.
recovery.linkNote: The link works once and expires after an hour.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your {{productName}} account has just been changed, and we logged you out on every other device. If this wasn’t you, reset your password now.
passwordChanged.linkNote: You can see where you’re logged in under Settings.

emailChange.subject: Your code to change your email
emailChange.heading: Your code to change your email address
emailChange.body: Someone asked to change the email address of a {{productName}} account. We send one code to the current address and another to the new one. Type both in Settings, and the change happens only once both are right. Until then, the current address keeps working.
emailChange.linkNote: The code works once and expires after an hour.

notificationEmails.subjectDecision: A moderation decision about something you posted
notificationEmails.digestIntro: Here’s what happened on {{productName}} since yesterday:
notificationEmails.moderationDecision: Our moderation team made a decision about something you posted. Open your notifications to read the reasons and how to appeal.
notificationEmails.why: You get these emails because of your choices in Settings, under Notifications: {{link}}
notificationEmails.unsubscribe: Stop these emails with one click: {{link}}
notificationEmails.required: This email is about your account and safety, so we always send it.
notificationEmails.subjectLoginMethod: A change to how you log in to {{productName}}
notificationEmails.loginMethodAdded: A new way to log in was connected to your account. You can see them all in Settings, under Ways to log in. If this wasn’t you, change your password and contact us.
notificationEmails.loginMethodRemoved: A way to log in was disconnected from your account. You can see the ones left in Settings, under Ways to log in. If this wasn’t you, change your password and contact us.

parentConsent.requestSubject: @{{handle}} asked you to agree to their {{productName}} account
parentConsent.requestBody: Someone who signed up to {{productName}} as @{{handle}} gave your email as their parent or guardian. They’re under 16, so they need you to agree before they can publish, comment, post or send messages. Until then they can only read.
parentConsent.requestAction: Read what we keep and how we protect under-18s, then answer: {{link}}
parentConsent.requestDeadline: If nobody says yes by {{deadline}}, we delete the account and its data.
parentConsent.agreedBody: Thank you. You agreed on {{date}}, so @{{handle}} can now publish, comment, post and send messages.
parentConsent.agreedWithdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time from the same page: {{link}}
parentConsent.withdrawnBody: We’ve made @{{handle}}’s account read-only. They can still read stories, but can’t publish, comment, post or send messages. If you have questions about what happens next, reply to this email.
parentConsent.refusedBody: Your parent or guardian didn’t agree, so we won’t activate your {{productName}} account, and we’ve deleted it and its data. You can sign up again later and ask another parent or guardian.

teacherCheck.linkBody: Someone asked for a Teacher badge on {{productName}} and gave this as their school address. Open the link to confirm it’s yours.
teacherCheck.linkNotYou: Didn’t ask for this? Ignore this email and nothing changes. The link stops working after a while.
